data.name: Hotel De Mendoza
data.address: C. Venustiano Carranza 16, Zona Centro, 44100 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
In the historic city center and a minute's walk from the neoclassical Teatro Degollado, this upscale hotel is a 4-minute walk from Guadalajara Cathedral.
Refined rooms feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and safes; suites add living rooms and breakfast areas. Upgraded suites have terraces with hot tubs. Room service is offered.
An elegant restaurant serves international cuisine. Other amenities include an outdoor pool, a hot tub and an exercise room, as well as a terrace and valet parking (surcharge).
